winning_headline: Secure Your Child's Tomorrow in 15 Minutes
winning_copy: As a parent, your family's financial security is your top priority. SecureNest Term Shield offers seamless digital approval up to 1 Crore with no medical exams needed. Invest in flexible protection today so you can cherish every moment worry-free.
reason_for_selection: Variant 3 adheres strictly to all brand rules. rejected_variants_notes: Variant 1 was rejected because the headline ('Protect Your Family's Future Today') leans slightly into fear-mongering and urgency, violating the empathetic tone guideline, and lacks a clear distinct CTA.
